title: From an HTML5 prototype to an RTS in Godot with AI help
author: This-Memory4929
selftext:
Hi everyone!

I'm here today to ask for some advice and to show you a prototype I've been working on, AQUILA VII.

The game simply comes from my love for RTS games, especially Praetorians. I loved that game when I was a kid, and for years I looked for something similar without really finding anything that scratched the same itch. Praetorians is what inspired me to start this project.

It all started as a small HTML5 prototype I made with the help of AI. I realized that, despite how basic it was, I liked it and actually had fun playing it. So I decided to take it a step further and bring it to PC using Godot.

From there, I wanted to keep improving it, make it look better, and most importantly make it something more people could enjoy.

That's why I also started using AI to translate the game's text into languages I don't speak and to generate the unit voices, which are available in five languages.

And those voices are exactly what I've been having doubts about lately. Since they're AI-generated, some of them sound a bit strange to me, not quite natural, and sometimes they don't really fit the setting.

So I'd like to ask you: what do you think of the voices? And of the game in general? Do you like it, or not really? Does it look like something you'd want to try playing?

But most importantly, do you think this is a game worth selling? Would anyone actually be willing to buy it? Could I realistically expect to make some money from it? And if so, would it make sense to invest more time and money into bringing it to Steam?

These are the questions I've been asking myself lately. I have plenty of other ideas too, and to me this is one of the most promising projects. Getting it ready for Steam the way I'd want would still take quite a bit of work, so before going down that road I'd like to hear what other people think.

I'll use your replies as a way to help me decide whether to keep investing in AQUILA VII or move on to something else. I'm not looking for positive comments only, I genuinely want to know what you think.

Thanks to anyone who takes the time to reply or gives the game a try!

You can find AQUILA VII and the free demo here:

[https://wasdlab.itch.io/aquila-vii](https://wasdlab.itch.io/aquila-vii)
